blocks.text: Megaspeed处于芯片走私争论的中心

inlines.text: Megaspeed处于芯片走私争论的中心

blocks.text: Megaspeed在东南亚多地运营数据中心，并向包括中国科技巨头阿里巴巴在内的企业提供算力。美国当局怀疑该公司是向中国转运受出口管制的英伟达芯片的后门。据报道，其马来西亚姊妹公司在2024年6月至2026年2月期间购买了价值至少48亿美元的含英伟达芯片AI硬件。

inlines.text: Megaspeed在东南亚多地运营数据中心，并向包括中国科技巨头阿里巴巴在内的企业提供算力。美国当局怀疑该公司是向中国转运受出口管制的英伟达芯片的后门。据报道，其马来西亚姊妹公司在2024年6月至2026年2月期间购买了价值至少48亿美元的含英伟达芯片AI硬件。

blocks.text: Megaspeed案指向一个更广泛的问题。尽管美国实施出口禁令，仍有价值数十亿美元的英伟达芯片通过东南亚走私网络流入中国。英伟达近期以更严格的芯片追踪措施回应。据彭博社报道，其“Fleet Intelligence”系统会记录AI加速器的位置，如今已成为该地区获得抢手的英伟达云合作伙伴（NCP）资格的一项要求。不过，与英伟达或美国政府共享位置数据仍是自愿的。英伟达今年早些时候还将预先批准的亚洲买家名单削减了一半，并将向中国企业转售算力的上限设为50%。

blocks.text: 黄仁勋推动对华芯片销售的游说正在失去阵地

inlines.text: 黄仁勋推动对华芯片销售的游说正在失去阵地

blocks.text: 多年来，黄仁勋一直推动英伟达及其他美国芯片制造商继续向中国销售AI处理器。他的论点是：将世界第二大芯片市场拒之门外，会促使中国建立独立且可能更优越的AI产业。他直接向特朗普政府陈述了这一观点，并于5月陪同特朗普总统访问北京。

inlines.text: 多年来，黄仁勋一直推动英伟达及其他美国芯片制造商继续向中国销售AI处理器。他的论点是：将世界第二大芯片市场拒之门外，会促使中国建立独立且可能更优越的AI产业。他直接向特朗普政府陈述了这一观点，并于5月陪同特朗普总统访问北京。

blocks.text: 这桩婚外情如今削弱了那项游说努力。共和党议员此前已要求在黄仁勋承认此事前与其举行简报会。在美国中期选举中民主党赢得国会两院后，更严格的出口管制变得更有可能。彭博情报指出，这桩婚外情削弱了英伟达的谈判地位，而正值新一届民主党国会将于1月接任委员会主席，并计划更密切地审查对华AI芯片出口。

blocks.text: 全球市值第二高的公司没有接班人计划

inlines.text: 全球市值第二高的公司没有接班人计划

blocks.text: 英伟达市值约4.5万亿美元，是全球市值第二高的公司。黄仁勋打造这家公司时没有采用传统的层级结构：约60人直接向他汇报，公司也没有公开的接班人计划。伯恩斯坦分析师Stacy Rasgon警告称，黄仁勋“就是英伟达”，公司里大部分事都由他亲自拍板。与Meta的马克·扎克伯格不同，黄仁勋不持有双重股权。他的持股比例略低于4%，这无法让他免于被董事会或股东罢免。

blocks.text: Megaspeed sits at the center of the chip smuggling debate

inlines.text: Megaspeed sits at the center of the chip smuggling debate

blocks.text: Megaspeed operates data centers across Southeast Asia and provides computing capacity to companies including Chinese tech giant Alibaba. US authorities suspect the company serves as a backdoor for transferring export-controlled Nvidia chips to China. A Malaysian sister company reportedly purchased AI hardware containing Nvidia chips worth at least $4.8 billion between June 2024 and February 2026.

inlines.text: Megaspeed operates data centers across Southeast Asia and provides computing capacity to companies including Chinese tech giant Alibaba. US authorities suspect the company serves as a backdoor for transferring export-controlled Nvidia chips to China. A Malaysian sister company reportedly purchased AI hardware containing Nvidia chips worth at least $4.8 billion between June 2024 and February 2026.

blocks.text: The Megaspeed case points to a broader problem. Despite US export bans, billions of dollars' worth of Nvidia chips are reaching China through smuggling networks in Southeast Asia. Nvidia recently responded with tighter chip tracking. Its "Fleet Intelligence" system logs the location of AI accelerators and is now a requirement for the coveted Nvidia Cloud Partner (NCP) status in the region, Bloomberg reports. Sharing location data with Nvidia or the US government remains voluntary, though. Nvidia also removed half of its pre-approved Asian buyers from its list earlier this year and capped the resale of computing capacity to Chinese firms at 50 percent.

blocks.text: Huang's lobbying push for China chip sales is losing ground

inlines.text: Huang's lobbying push for China chip sales is losing ground

blocks.text: Huang has spent years pushing for Nvidia and other US chipmakers to keep selling AI processors to China. His argument: shutting out the world's second-largest chip market would push China to build an independent and potentially superior AI industry. He made this case directly to the Trump administration and accompanied President Trump on a trip to Beijing in May.

blocks.text: The affair now undermines that lobbying effort. Republican lawmakers had already demanded a briefing with Huang before his admission. Bloomberg Intelligence notes that the affair weakens Nvidia's bargaining position right as the new Democratic Congress takes over committee chairs in January and plans to scrutinize AI chip exports to China more closely.

blocks.text: No succession plan for the world's second most valuable company

inlines.text: No succession plan for the world's second most valuable company

blocks.text: Nvidia has a market cap of roughly $4.5 trillion, making it the second most valuable company in the world. Huang built the company without a conventional hierarchy: about 60 people report directly to him, and there is no public succession plan. Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon warned that Huang "is Nvidia" and personally pulls most of the strings at the company. Unlike Mark Zuckerberg at Meta, Huang doesn't hold dual-class shares. His stake of just under four percent offers him no protection against removal by the board or shareholders.
